from calc.calc import topla, cikar, carp, bol

def test_topla():
    assert topla(2, 3) == 5
    assert topla(-1, 1) == 0
    assert topla(0, 0) == 0

def test_cikar():
    assert cikar(5, 3) == 2
    assert cikar(0, 5) == -5
    assert cikar(-1, -1) == 0

def test_carp():
    assert carp(3, 4) == 12
    assert carp(-2, 3) == -6
    assert carp(0, 5) == 0

def test_bol():
    assert bol(10, 2) == 5
    assert bol(5, 2) == 2.5
    assert bol(-6, 3) == -2.0

def test_bol_sifira():
    try:
        bol(5, 0)
        assert False, "Sıfıra bölme ValueError beklenirdi"
    except ValueError as e:
        assert str(e) == "Sıfıra bölme hatası"
